section_summary.extract_value: This section reports one sample of 309 Portuguese women from the general population (aged 18–50, M=23.00, SD=6.37). Mean education was 13.54 years (SD=1.56). Mean BMI was 22.28 (SD=3.09) with 7.12% underweight, 77.35% normal weight, and 15.53% overweight.
